casual.description: Honestly, the teacher asked me one thing and I had no idea what to say. Watch till the end!

funny.title: My body asked a question. I left.

list.title: Three things about yoga

What happens in this clip:
- He tries yoga
- The teacher asks one question
- He has no answer

story.title: The day I tried yoga
story.description: He walks into a yoga class. The teacher asks him one question. He stands there with no answer. The room laughs.
